title: Share the exact Simulator with a remote coding agent
summary: Cameron Cooke demonstrates selecting a Mac-hosted Simulator from an iPhone Duo, using its lower half as a trackpad, and adapting the mirror to rotation. An iOS team can pass the exposed Simulator identifier to its coding agent so both inspect the same instance; the post describes work in progress and does not demonstrate agent-driven acceptance testing.
takeaway: Pin the agent to the Simulator identifier selected in the remote viewer, then inspect the changed flow together; treat the demo as a preview of the workflow.
